answer: The dune counter is kept in nebula and knoll publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 189 aliases cost 253 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
